from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class IndependentSmaRsiStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        indicators_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
        has_spy_cross_history = self.previous_spy_close is not None and self.previous_spy_sma is not None

        if indicators_ready and has_spy_cross_history:
            spy_cross_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )
            if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_cross_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if indicators_ready and self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if indicators_ready and has_spy_cross_history and self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
            spy_cross_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )
            if spy_cross_above:
                shares = int(math.floor(float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40 / float(spy_close)))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if indicators_ready and self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(math.floor(20000 / float(aapl_close)))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

from AlgorithmImports import *


class PrivateLotStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_close_count = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
            self.aapl_close_count += 1

        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        if not all_bars_present:
            if spy_bar is not None:
                if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                    self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            return

        if (
            not self.spy_sma.IsReady
            or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            or self.previous_spy_close is None
            or self.previous_spy_sma is None
            or self.aapl_close_count < 4
        ):
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
            return

        spy_sma_today = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        aapl_rsi_today = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close > spy_sma_today
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_bar.Close < spy_sma_today
        )

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_rsi_today > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)

                    self.rsi_average_loss = self.rsi_loss_sum / 14.0
                    self.aapl_rsi_ready = True
                    self.aapl_rsi = self.CalculateRsi()
            else:

                    (self.rsi_average_gain * 13.0 + gain) / 14.0
                )

    def CalculateRsi(self):
        if self.rsi_average_loss == 0:
            return 100.0
        relative_strength = self.rsi_average_gain / self.rsi_average_loss
        return 100.0 - (100.0 / (1.0 + relative_strength))

class ExactStrategySystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_cross_above = False
        self.spy_cross_below = False

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Continuously update market-state quantities whenever their own bar exists.
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

            previous_sma = None
            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
                previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

            previous_close = self.spy_previous_close
            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)

            current_sma = None
            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
                current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

            self.spy_cross_above = (
                previous_close is not None
                and previous_sma is not None
                and current_sma is not None
                and previous_close <= previous_sma
                and spy_close > current_sma
            )
            self.spy_cross_below = (
                previous_close is not None
                and previous_sma is not None
                and current_sma is not None
                and previous_close >= previous_sma
                and spy_close < current_sma
            )
            self.spy_previous_close = spy_close

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker is missing today's bar.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self.spy_cross_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and self.spy_cross_above
            and len(self.spy_closes) == 100
        ):
            quantity = int(math.floor(float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40 / float(spy_close)))

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
import math


class ExactStrategySystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_cross_above = False
        self.spy_cross_below = False

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Continuously update market-state quantities whenever their own bar exists.
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

            previous_sma = None
            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
                previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

            previous_close = self.spy_previous_close
            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)

            current_sma = None
            if len(self.spy_closes) == 100:
                current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

            self.spy_cross_above = (
                previous_close is not None
                and previous_sma is not None
                and current_sma is not None
                and previous_close <= previous_sma
                and spy_close > current_sma
            )
            self.spy_cross_below = (
                previous_close is not None
                and previous_sma is not None
                and current_sma is not None
                and previous_close >= previous_sma
                and spy_close < current_sma
            )
            self.spy_previous_close = spy_close

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker is missing today's bar.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and self.spy_cross_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if (
            self.strategy_a_lot == 0
            and self.spy_cross_above
            and len(self.spy_closes) == 100
        ):
            quantity = int(math.floor(float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40 / float(spy_close)))
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
        ):
            quantity = int(math.floor(20_000 / float(aapl_close)))
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_lot = quantity
